noveltyJustification: Reset wiring enumerated end to end (session-prime, post-compaction, Cursor precompact, Codex mirrors, OpenCode epoch map, Pi in-memory reset) plus two design deltas the machinery does not cover (delivered-set keying; transcript-evidence dependency outside Claude).

statement: Marker: reuse the directive-lifecycle receipt (schema v2: directives/transcriptPath/transcriptHighWaterBytes/storeGeneration/lifecycleEpoch) with proven-repeat suppression; spec-gate field naming (questionDeliveredAtMs/Channel/Count) is the naming precedent only, not the reset model.

Storage: durable store at $SPECKIT_DIRECTIVE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_DIR or tmpdir()/speckit-advisor/directive-lifecycle/<project-hash>/<session-hash>.json with generation/epoch/poison files; Pi in-memory globalThis map; OpenCode in-process epoch map; spec-gate alternative at .skilled/skills/.state/spec-gate/.

Reset event: compaction boundary via three converging signals - boundary events from registered owners (session-prime, post-compaction, cursor precompact, codex session-start; boundary enum startup|resume|compact|clear|post-compact), transcript shrink, and durable epoch advance (null session invalidates all records).

Runtime coverage: Claude/Devin/Codex/OpenCode/Pi covered; Cursor reset covered but delivery contradicted within the contract (beforeSubmitPrompt dormant per live probe) - treat as not covered pending probe. Decisive caveat: dedup proof requires transcript evidence; without it delivery stays full every turn, so once-per-window is NOT met by existing machinery on transcript-less runtimes.
Design delta: dedup key today is whole-payload equality; 'a given rule at most once' needs a delivered-card set (or per-rule receipts) - new design work, not a configuration of existing machinery.
Inherited bounds: two events in flight can both deliver (accepted as harmless precedent); kill switches restore full behavior; every uncertainty fails open to full delivery.
